ownerDecisions: No project: the module is recorded, not ported (the shaded-jar test of the JVM build). Owner decision 2026-11-16 (JVM-only units are recorded with their CLR counterpart instead of placeholder files) and 2026-11-23 (units that need a Java library without a BCL counterpart are recorded, not ported).

statusMeaning.deprecated-not-ported: @Deprecated Java unit (or a unit that serves one) recorded with its deprecation facts; no [Obsolete] facade.
statusMeaning.jvm-only-replaced: JVM-only unit replaced by its recorded CLR counterpart, or JVM build/runtime material with no CLR counterpart.
statusMeaning.library-not-ported: Needs a Java library or JDK-specific API with no BCL counterpart (owner decision 2026-11-23); recorded, not ported.
statusMeaning.clr-adapted: Ported with the original names, structure and comments; every CLR difference is stated in a // CLR: comment and in this entry.
statusMeaning.verified: Every declared original test is mapped to a C# test with the same name (case may differ) and passes.
